3396: newEffect{
3397: 	name = "HEALING_INVERSION",
3398: 	desc = _t"Healing Inversion", image = "talents/healing_inversion.png",
3399: 	long_desc = function(self, eff) return ("All healing done to the target will instead turn into %d%% blight damage."):tformat(eff.power) end,
3400: 	type = "magical",
3401: 	subtype = { heal=true },
3402: 	status = "detrimental",
3403: 	parameters = { power=10 },
3404: 	on_gain = function(self, err) return nil, _t"+Healing Inversion" end,
3405: 	on_lose = function(self, err) return nil, _t"-Healing Inversion" end,
3406: 	callbackPriorities={callbackOnHeal = 1}, -- trigger after (most) other healing callbacks
3407: 	callbackOnHeal = function(self, eff, value, src, raw_value)
3408: 		if raw_value > 0 and not eff.projecting then -- avoid feedback; it's bad to lose out on dmg but it's worse to break the game
3409: 			eff.projecting = true
3410: 			local dam = raw_value * eff.power / 100
3411: 			eff.src.__project_source = eff
3412: 			DamageType:get(DamageType.BLIGHT).projector(eff.src, self.x, self.y, DamageType.BLIGHT, dam)
3413: 			eff.src.__project_source = nil
3414: 			eff.projecting = false
3415: 		end
3416: 		return {value=0}
3417: 	end,
3418: 	activate = function(self, eff)
3419: 		eff.particle = self:addParticles(Particles.new("circle", 1, {oversize=0.7, a=90, appear=8, speed=-2, img="necromantic_circle", radius=0}))
3420: 	end,
3421: 	deactivate = function(self, eff)
3422: 		self:removeParticles(eff.particle)
3423: 	end,
3424: }
